data.ruling: The refutation holds, with function scope. IOBoard.md:54 states a requirement for the whole board: "every signal that reaches an RP2354B pin is at 3.3 V logic". It applies to this function. The switch's upstream SDA and SCL are the coprocessor's I2C bus (IOBoard.md:462), so they land on RP2354B pins. The Q7 value "2 ports at 3.3 V" (IOBoard.md:74, :463) constrains only the downstream port side. A translating switch lets each channel pull up to its own rail, so a 3.3 V port does not force a 3.3 V upstream bus. The other three R12 lists (thermocouple, infrared, non-volatile store) each carry IOBoard.md:54 as an entry. The external I2C ports list, in the claim and in the T4 P2 return, has no such entry. The T4 datasheet verifier cited :54 and wrote "all in the list", which does not match the list. The list must add the entry "3.3 V logic at the RP2354B: the upstream SDA and SCL at 3.3 V logic (IOBoard.md:54)". The change stops at the list. It is not about either part, and both verified parts meet the entry. TCA9548APWR and alternate PCA9548APWR stay selected, and no next-ranked candidate is sent to verifiers.
